title_en: LearniBridge: Learnable Calibration of Feature Caching for Diffusion Models Acceleration
title_zh: LearniBridge：用于扩散模型加速的特征缓存可学习校准

sentences.en: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have driven substantial progress in image and video generation but suffer from prohibitive computational costs.
sentences.zh: 扩散Transformer（DiTs）推动了图像和视频生成的重大进展，但计算成本过高。

sentences.en: Feature caching accelerates inference by reusing intermediate representations.
sentences.zh: 特征缓存通过重用中间表示来加速推理。

sentences.en: Existing methods rely on historical features for implementation simplicity,  yet suffer from severe error accumulation at high acceleration ratios.
sentences.zh: 现有方法出于实现简单的考虑依赖历史特征，但在高加速比下遭受严重的误差累积。

sentences.en: To address this limitation, we investigate the nature of the requisite feature correction.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一局限，我们研究必要的特征修正的本质。

sentences.en: We demonstrate that the optimal calibration update is characterized by a shared low-rank subspace across diverse prompts.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，最优的校准更新具有跨不同提示共享的低秩子空间的特性。

sentences.en: Guided by this structural insight, we propose LearniBridge, a learnable calibration mechanism for feature caching that bridges multiple timesteps through lightweight LoRA updates.
sentences.zh: 在这一结构洞见的指导下，我们提出LearniBridge，一种用于特征缓存的可学习校准机制，通过轻量级LoRA更新桥接多个时间步。

sentences.en: This mechanism enables effective calibration requiring only $3-5$ training samples.
sentences.zh: 该机制仅需$3-5$个训练样本即可实现有效校准。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on image and video generation show that LearniBridge achieves up to $5.87\times$, $5.75\times$, and $4.10\times$ acceleration on FLUX, HunyuanVideo, and WAN 2.1, respectively.
sentences.zh: 在图像和视频生成上的大量实验表明，LearniBridge在FLUX、HunyuanVideo和WAN 2.1上分别实现了最高$5.87\times$、$5.75\times$和$4.10\times$的加速。

sentences.en: On WAN 2.1, it improves VBench by 1.28\% over the previous SOTA at $4.10\times$ acceleration.
sentences.zh: 在WAN 2.1上，它在$4.10\times$加速下将VBench提升了1.28\%，优于先前的SOTA。

topic: Probabilistic Methods->Monte Carlo and Sampling Methods
title_en: Learning $U$-Statistics with Active Inference
title_zh: 利用主动推断学习$U$-统计量

sentences.en: $U$-statistics play a central role in statistical inference.
sentences.zh: $U$-统计量在统计推断中扮演核心角色。

sentences.en: In many modern applications, however, acquiring the labels required for $U$-statistics is costly.
sentences.zh: 然而，在许多现代应用中，获取$U$-统计量所需的标签成本高昂。

sentences.en: Motivated by recent advances in active inference, we develop an active inference framework for $U$-statistics that selectively queries informative labels to improve estimation efficiency under a fixed labeling budget, while preserving valid statistical inference.
sentences.zh: 受主动推断近期进展的启发，我们为$U$-统计量开发了一个主动推断框架，在固定标注预算下选择性地查询信息量丰富的标签以提高估计效率，同时保持有效的统计推断。

sentences.en: Our approach is built on the augmented inverse probability weighting $U$-statistic, which is proposed to incorporate the sampling rule and machine learning predictions.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法建立在增广逆概率加权$U$-统计量之上，该统计量被提出来整合采样规则和机器学习预测。

sentences.en: We characterize the optimal sampling rule that minimizes its variance and design practical sampling strategies.
sentences.zh: 我们刻画了使方差最小化的最优采样规则，并设计了实用的采样策略。

sentences.en: We further extend the framework to $U$-statistic-based empirical risk minimization.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步将该框架扩展到基于$U$-统计量的经验风险最小化。

sentences.en: Experiments on real datasets demonstrate substantial gains in estimation efficiency over baseline methods, while maintaining target coverage.
sentences.zh: 在真实数据集上的实验表明，相对于基线方法，我们的方法在保持目标覆盖率的同时在估计效率上取得了显著提升。

title_en: Learning 3D-Gaussian Simulators from RGB Videos
title_zh: 从RGB视频学习3D高斯模拟器

sentences.en: Realistic simulation is critical for applications ranging from robotics to animation.
sentences.zh: 逼真的模拟对于从机器人技术到动画的各种应用都至关重要。

sentences.en: Video generation models have emerged as a way to capture real-world physics from data, but they often face challenges in maintaining spatial consistency and object permanence, relying on memory mechanisms to compensate.
sentences.zh: 视频生成模型已作为从数据中捕捉真实世界物理的一种方式而出现，但它们往往在保持空间一致性和物体恒存性方面面临挑战，需要依靠记忆机制来弥补。

sentences.en: As a complementary direction, we present 3DGSim, a learned 3D simulator that directly learns physical interactions from multi-view RGB videos.
sentences.zh: 作为一种互补的方向，我们提出3DGSim，一个直接从多视角RGB视频学习物理交互的学习式3D模拟器。

sentences.en: 3DGSim adopts MVSplat to learn a latent particle-based representation of 3D scenes, a Point Transformer for the particle dynamics, a Temporal Merging module for consistent temporal aggregation, and Gaussian Splatting to produce novel view renderings.
sentences.zh: 3DGSim采用MVSplat学习3D场景的基于潜在粒子的表示，采用Point Transformer建模粒子动态，采用时间合并（Temporal Merging）模块实现一致的时间聚合，并使用高斯溅射（Gaussian Splatting）生成新视角渲染。

sentences.en: By jointly training inverse rendering and dynamics forecasting, 3DGSim embeds physical properties into point-wise latent features.
sentences.zh: 通过联合训练逆渲染和动态预测，3DGSim将物理属性嵌入逐点的潜在特征中。

sentences.en: This enables the model to capture diverse behaviors, from rigid and elastic to cloth-like dynamics and boundary conditions (e.g., fixed cloth corners), while producing realistic lighting effects.
sentences.zh: 这使得模型能够捕捉多种行为，从刚体、弹性到类布料动态以及边界条件（例如固定的布料角落），同时产生逼真的光照效果。

sentences.en: We show that 3DGSim can generate physically plausible results even in out of distribution cases, e.g. ground removal or multi-object interactions, despite being trained only on single-body collisions.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，尽管只在单物体碰撞上训练，3DGSim即使在分布外情况下（例如移除地面或多物体交互）也能生成物理上合理的结果。

title_en: Learning a Generative Meta-Model of LLM Activations
title_zh: 学习LLM激活的生成式元模型

sentences.en: Existing approaches for analyzing neural network activations, such as PCA and sparse autoencoders, rely on strong structural assumptions.
sentences.zh: 分析神经网络激活的现有方法，如PCA和稀疏自编码器，依赖强结构假设。

sentences.en: Generative models offer an alternative: they can uncover structure without such assumptions and act as priors that improve intervention fidelity.
sentences.zh: 生成式模型提供了一种替代方案：它们能够在没有此类假设的情况下揭示结构，并作为改进干预保真度的先验。

sentences.en: We explore this direction by training diffusion models on one billion residual stream activations, creating "meta-models" that learn the distribution of a network's internal states.
sentences.zh: 我们通过在十亿残差流激活上训练扩散模型来探索这一方向，创建学习网络内部状态分布的\"元模型\"。

sentences.en: We find that diffusion loss decreases smoothly with compute and reliably predicts downstream utility.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，扩散损失随计算量平滑下降，并能可靠地预测下游效用。

sentences.en: In particular, applying the meta-model's learned prior to steering interventions improves fluency, with larger gains as loss decreases.
sentences.zh: 特别是，将元模型学习到的先验应用于引导干预可以提升流畅度，且随着损失的降低增益更大。

sentences.en: Moreover, the meta-model's neurons increasingly isolate concepts into individual units, with sparse probing scores that scale as loss decreases.
sentences.zh: 此外，元模型的神经元越来越将概念隔离到各个单元中，稀疏探测分数随损失降低而提高。

sentences.en: These results suggest generative meta-models offer a scalable path toward interpretability without restrictive structural assumptions.
sentences.zh: 这些结果表明，生成式元模型为无需限制性结构假设的可解释性提供了一条可扩展的路径。

title_en: Learning a Zeroth-Order Optimizer for Fine-Tuning LLMs
title_zh: 学习用于微调LLM的零阶优化器

sentences.en: Zeroth-order optimizers have recently emerged as an attractive approach for fine-tuning large language models (LLMs), as they avoid backpropagation and can substantially reduce memory overhead relative to standard first-order training.
sentences.zh: 零阶优化器近来已成为微调大语言模型（LLMs）的一种有吸引力的方法，因为它们避免了反向传播，并能相对于标准一阶训练大幅降低内存开销。

sentences.en: However, existing zeroth-order methods rely on hand-crafted, static sampling strategies that are not adaptable to model-specific structures.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的零阶方法依赖手工设计的、静态的采样策略，无法适应模型特定的结构。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose ZO-Finetuner, a learning-based zeroth-order optimizer for LLMs that automatically learns efficient perturbation strategies through a compact and memory-efficient design.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们提出ZO-Finetuner，一种基于学习的、用于LLM的零阶优化器，通过紧凑且内存高效的设计自动学习高效的扰动策略。

sentences.en: Motivated by the fact that a small set of base LLMs is repeatedly fine-tuned across tasks, ZO-Finetuner supports one-time per-model training and reuse across downstream tasks with minimal overhead.
sentences.zh: 基于一小批基础LLM会在多个任务上被反复微调这一事实，ZO-Finetuner支持每个模型一次性训练，并以最小的开销在各种下游任务间复用。

sentences.en: Therefore, learning the optimizer once for a given LLM and reusing it across diverse downstream tasks is both feasible and highly desirable.
sentences.zh: 因此，为给定的LLM学习一次优化器并在各种下游任务间复用它，既可行又非常可取。

sentences.en: Accordingly, ZO-Finetuner is designed to scale learning to learn (L2L) to the foundation-model era by supporting one-time per-model training with minimal overhead.
sentences.zh: 相应地，ZO-Finetuner被设计为通过支持每个模型一次性训练并保持最小开销，将元学习（learning to learn，L2L）扩展到基础模型时代。

sentences.en: Experiments on 4 LLMs and 7 datasets show that ZO-Finetuner outperforms prior zeroth-order baselines in 82.1\% of task-model combinations, thereby demonstrating strong performance and scalability for efficient LLM fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 在4个LLM和7个数据集上的实验表明，ZO-Finetuner在82.1\%的任务-模型组合中优于先前的零阶基线，从而展示了高效LLM微调的强劲性能和可扩展性。

title_en: Learning Adaptive Perturbation-Conditioned Contexts for Robust Transcriptional Response Prediction
title_zh: 学习自适应扰动条件化上下文用于稳健的转录响应预测

sentences.en: Predicting high-dimensional transcriptional responses to genetic perturbations is challenging because signals are sparse and experimental noise is severe.
sentences.zh: 预测对遗传扰动的高维转录响应具有挑战性，因为信号稀疏且实验噪声严重。

sentences.en: Existing methods often suffer from mean collapse, achieving high correlation by predicting the global average expression rather than perturbation-specific responses, which yields false positives and poor interpretability.
sentences.zh: 现有方法往往遭受均值坍缩，通过预测全局平均表达量而非扰动特定的响应来获得高相关性，这会导致假阳性和较差的可解释性。

sentences.en: Methods that add biological knowledge graphs typically treat them as dense, static priors shared across perturbations, propagating noise.
sentences.zh: 引入生物学知识图谱的方法通常将其视为跨扰动共享的密集、静态先验，从而传播噪声。

sentences.en: We propose AdaPert, which counters mean collapse by extracting a sparse, perturbation-specific subgraph via differentiable node selection, then suppressing spurious variation in non-responsive genes while emphasizing differentially expressed ones.
sentences.zh: 我们提出AdaPert，通过可微的节点选择提取稀疏的、扰动特定的子图来对抗均值坍缩，然后抑制非响应基因中的虚假变异，同时强调差异表达基因。

sentences.en: Across multiple benchmarks, AdaPert outperforms existing baselines, with the largest gains on DEG-aware metrics.
sentences.zh: 在多个基准上，AdaPert优于现有基线，在DEG感知指标上取得最大增益。

title_en: Learning Adaptive Topology with FiLM-Guided Distillation for Tertiary Structure-Based RNA Design
title_zh: 利用FiLM引导蒸馏学习自适应拓扑用于基于三级结构的RNA设计

sentences.en: Tertiary structure-based RNA design aims to generate RNA sequences that can fold into desired 3D structures, but remains a challenging problem due to the scarcity of annotated data, structural noise, and the intrinsic complexity of RNA topology.
sentences.zh: 基于三级结构的RNA设计旨在生成能够折叠为所需3D结构的RNA序列，但由于标注数据稀缺、结构噪声以及RNA拓扑的内在复杂性，这一问题仍具挑战性。

sentences.en: Existing structure-to-sequence frameworks largely rely on static k-nearest neighbor graphs and rigid message passing schemes, which fail to capture the flexible and heterogeneous nature of RNA geometry.
sentences.zh: 现有的结构到序列框架在很大程度上依赖静态的k近邻图和刚性消息传递方案，无法捕捉RNA几何结构的灵活性与异质性。

sentences.en: To address these issues, we propose a unified framework, ATL-FGD, that integrates Adaptive Topology Learning (ATL) and FiLM-Guided Distillation (FGD) for robust RNA design.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些问题，我们提出统一框架ATL-FGD，整合了自适应拓扑学习（ATL）与FiLM引导蒸馏（FGD），用于稳健的RNA设计。

sentences.en: ATL introduces a differentiable edge gating mechanism to jointly learn topology and representation, enabling the model to construct data-driven, layer-adaptive graphs that better reflect structural dynamics and biochemical consistency.
sentences.zh: ATL引入可微的边门控机制来联合学习拓扑和表示，使模型能够构建数据驱动、逐层自适应的图，从而更好地反映结构动态和生化一致性。

sentences.en: On top of this, FGD bridges structural and sequence representations via feature-wise linear modulation, softly transferring the semantic knowledge from RNA foundation models without relying on them during inference.
sentences.zh: 在此基础之上，FGD通过逐特征线性调制在结构与序列表示之间架起桥梁，温和地将RNA基础模型的语义知识迁移过来，而无需在推理时依赖这些模型。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on tertiary structure-based RNA design benchmarks demonstrate that our approach achieves significant improvements in both sequence recovery and structural fidelity.
sentences.zh: 在基于三级结构的RNA设计基准上的大量实验表明，我们的方法在序列恢复和结构保真度方面均取得了显著改进。

title_en: Learning Anisotropic Value Geometry with Finsler Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 用Finsler强化学习学习各向异性值几何

sentences.en: We introduce **Finslerian Reinforcement Learning (FiRL)**, an RL framework that makes directional costs explicit and improves robustness to tail risk.
sentences.zh: 我们引入**Finsler强化学习（FiRL）**，一个使方向性代价显式化并提升对尾部风险鲁棒性的RL框架。

sentences.en: FiRL incorporates a *Finsler metric* into the locomotion cost, expressing effort as $F(x,v)$ that depends on the state $x$ and motion $v$, so it can capture uphill versus downhill asymmetry, lateral slip, and other direction-dependent effects.
sentences.zh: FiRL在行走代价中融入一个*Finsler度量*，将努力表示为依赖于状态$x$和运动$v$的$F(x,v)$，从而能够捕捉上坡与下坡的不对称性、侧向滑移以及其他方向依赖的效应。

sentences.en: To handle rare but catastrophic outcomes, FiRL optimizes a Conditional Value-at-Risk ($CVaR_\alpha$) objective.
sentences.zh: 为处理罕见但灾难性的结果，FiRL优化条件风险价值（$CVaR_\alpha$）目标。

sentences.en: We derive the corresponding risk-sensitive Bellman equation and show that the resulting CVaR--Finsler Bellman operator is a $\gamma$-contraction.
sentences.zh: 我们推导出相应的风险敏感Bellman方程，并表明由此得到的CVaR--Finsler Bellman算子是$\gamma$-压缩映射。

sentences.en: This guarantees a unique fixed-point value function, while the underlying Finsler cost induces an asymmetric path cost $d_F$ that satisfies a triangle inequality despite directional asymmetry.
sentences.zh: 这保证了唯一不动点的值函数，而底层Finsler代价诱导出非对称路径代价$d_F$，尽管存在方向不对称性，它仍满足三角形不等式。

sentences.en: We then develop a FiRL actor--critic algorithm to learn policies under this anisotropic, risk-averse objective.
sentences.zh: 然后我们开发了FiRL actor--critic算法，在这一各向异性、风险规避的目标下学习策略。

sentences.en: Across simulation benchmarks and real-world robot trials, FiRL demonstrates safer and more energy-efficient locomotion behavior than strong baselines such as risk-neutral PPO.
sentences.zh: 在仿真基准和真实机器人试验中，与风险中性PPO等强基线相比，FiRL展现出更安全、更节能的行走行为。

sentences.en: For instance, on a $12^\circ$ sloped Hopper task, FiRL reduces worst-case ($CVaR_{0.1}$) impact forces by over 35% and total energy cost by 15%, while also improving success rate.
sentences.zh: 例如，在$12^\circ$坡度的Hopper任务上，FiRL将最坏情况（$CVaR_{0.1}$）冲击力降低超过35%，总能量成本降低15%，同时还提升了成功率。

title_en: Learning Attribute–Affordance Hierarchies in Hyperbolic Space for Open-Vocabulary 3D Object Affordance Grounding
title_zh: 在双曲空间中学习属性-可供性层级用于开放词汇3D物体可供性接地

sentences.en: This paper pays attention to open-vocabulary 3D object affordance grounding (OVAG), which aims to localize affordance regions on 3D objects by leveraging interaction images or textual instructions.
sentences.zh: 本文关注开放词汇3D物体可供性接地（OVAG），其旨在通过利用交互图像或文本指令来定位3D物体上的可供性区域。

sentences.en: Most existing methods treat interaction images as sources of external affordance knowledge and align them with 3D visual representations, while overlooking the intrinsic relationship between local object attributes and affordances, which limits localization accuracy and generalization.
sentences.zh: 大多数现有方法将交互图像视为外部可供性知识的来源，并将其与3D视觉表示对齐，而忽视了局部物体属性与可供性之间的内在关系，这限制了定位精度和泛化能力。

sentences.en: For instance, a cup handle affords grasping due to its curved shape and appropriate thickness, indicating that affordances emerge from specific attribute compositions rather than global object appearance.
sentences.zh: 例如，杯子的手柄因其弯曲的形状和合适的厚度而能供人抓握，这表明可供性源于特定的属性组合，而非物体的整体外观。

sentences.en: Motivated by this, we propose Attribute-Affordance Hierarchies (AAH) learning framework that explicitly models the hierarchical relationships between object-region attributes and affordances.
sentences.zh: 基于此，我们提出属性-可供性层级（AAH）学习框架，显式建模物体区域属性与可供性之间的层级关系。

sentences.en: Our approach first captures local region relationships using hypergraph, and then projects these region-level concepts into a hyperbolic space to encode their hierarchical organization.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法首先使用超图捕捉局部区域关系，然后将这些区域级概念投影到双曲空间中，以编码其层级组织。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we introduce counterfactual attribute samples to encourage robust learning of attribute–affordance dependencies under varying conditions.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们引入反事实属性样本，以促进在不同条件下对属性-可供性依赖关系的稳健学习。

sentences.en: By jointly modeling visual structure and hierarchical concept information, our method achieves more accurate affordance localization.
sentences.zh: 通过联合建模视觉结构和层级概念信息，我们的方法实现了更准确的可供性定位。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments and qualitative analyses demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.
sentences.zh: 大量实验和定性分析证明了我们方法的有效性。

title_en: Learning Biophysical Models of Large-Scale Multineuronal Data To Enable Precise Neurostimulation
title_zh: 学习大规模多神经元数据的生物物理模型以实现精确神经刺激

sentences.en: Multi-compartment Hodgkin–Huxley (HH) models provide a principled framework for predicting neural dynamics and responses to electrical stimulation.
sentences.zh: 多房室Hodgkin–Huxley（HH）模型为预测神经动态和对电刺激的响应提供了一个有原则的框架。

sentences.en: However, fitting HH biophysical parameters typically requires intracellular recordings, which are invasive and low-throughput, limiting the ability to capture the geometry and cell-specific properties of many neurons in a given neural circuit.
sentences.zh: 然而，拟合HH生物物理参数通常需要细胞内记录，这种记录具有侵入性且通量较低，限制了捕捉给定神经回路中许多神经元的几何形状和细胞特异性属性的能力。

sentences.en: Multi-electrode arrays (MEAs) offer a scalable alternative—high-density extracellular measurements from full neural populations—but HH model complexity has so far precluded reliable biophysical inference from extracellular data alone.
sentences.zh: 多电极阵列（MEAs）提供了一种可扩展的替代方案——来自完整神经群体的高密度细胞外测量——但HH模型的复杂性迄今阻碍了仅从细胞外数据中进行可靠的生物物理推断。

sentences.en: Here, we introduce a framework that rapidly infers HH parameters from designed features of extracellular MEA measurements by leveraging differentiable biophysical simulation and simulation-based inference, unlocking a wide range of downstream applications.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们引入一个框架，通过利用可微生物物理模拟和基于模拟的推断，从细胞外MEA测量的设计特征中快速推断HH参数，从而开启广泛的下游应用。

sentences.en: In this work, we focus on a central goal of translational neuroengineering: predicting neural spiking responses to candidate neurostimulation patterns that would take hours to measure clinically.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们聚焦于转化神经工程的一个核心目标：预测神经元对候选神经刺激模式的尖峰响应，而这些模式在临床上需要花费数小时来测量。

sentences.en: To validate our approach, we collected hundreds of hours of stimulation and recording data from isolated macaque retina with a 30 µm-pitch 512-electrode array.
sentences.zh: 为验证我们的方法，我们使用30微米间距的512电极阵列，收集了来自离体猕猴视网膜的数百小时刺激与记录数据。

sentences.en: Our framework predicted previously unseen multi-electrode stimulation responses with 90.4\% accuracy using HH models fit from only a few minutes of recording, replacing hours of stimulus testing.
sentences.zh: 我们的框架利用仅从几分钟记录中拟合出的HH模型，以90.4\%的准确率预测了先前未见过的多电极刺激响应，取代了数小时的刺激测试。

title_en: Learning Cardiac Latent Representations in Vectorcardiogram Space
title_zh: 在心电向量图空间中学习心脏潜在表示

sentences.en: Electrocardiography (ECG) is a cornerstone of cardiac assessment, making the learning of informative ECG representations fundamental to tasks ranging from disease diagnosis to clinical report generation.
sentences.zh: 心电图（ECG）是心脏评估的基石，使得学习信息丰富的ECG表示对从疾病诊断到临床报告生成等各项任务都至关重要。

sentences.en: However, existing methods operate almost exclusively in the observable ECG signal space.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法几乎完全在可观测的ECG信号空间中运行。

sentences.en: In practice, the standard twelve-lead ECG represents multiple projections of the same underlying cardiac electrical activity from different spatial orientations.
sentences.zh: 在实践中，标准十二导联ECG表示同一底层心脏电活动从不同空间取向的多个投影。

sentences.en: Therefore, representation learning in the ECG space inevitably introduces substantial redundancy, which may lead to spurious correlations and increased risk of overfitting.
sentences.zh: 因此，在ECG空间中进行表示学习不可避免地会引入大量冗余，这可能导致虚假相关性并增加过拟合风险。

sentences.en: To address this and motivated by the Frank vectorcardiogram (VCG) model, we propose learning a unified latent representation of cardiac electrical activity directly in the VCG space.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，并受Frank心电向量图（VCG）模型启发，我们提出直接在VCG空间中学习心脏电活动的统一潜在表示。

sentences.en: We introduce LVCG, the first general self-supervised representation learning framework designed to operate in this physically grounded latent space.
sentences.zh: 我们介绍LVCG，第一个专门设计用于在该物理接地潜在空间中运行的通用自监督表示学习框架。

sentences.en: By learning view-invariant latent VCG representations rather than lead-specific artifacts, VCG minimizes redundancy and improves generalization.
sentences.zh: 通过学习视图不变（view-invariant）的潜在VCG表示而非导联特定的伪迹，VCG最小化了冗余并提升了泛化能力。

sentences.en: LVCG generally outperforms ECG-space baselines across tasks, demonstrating enhanced robustness and generalization, especially in domain shift settings.
sentences.zh: LVCG在各项任务上普遍优于ECG空间基线，展现出增强的鲁棒性和泛化能力，尤其是在域偏移设置中。

sentences.en: Our code has been made available at https://github.com/BosonHwang/LVCG.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码已在 https://github.com/BosonHwang/LVCG 提供。

title_en: Learning Coherent Representations: A Topological Approach to Interpretability
title_zh: 学习连贯表示：一种可解释性的拓扑方法

sentences.en: Deep neural networks learn representations where individual features often lack interpretable meaning; a single neuron may activate for scattered, unrelated inputs.
sentences.zh: 深度神经网络学习到的表示中，各个特征往往缺乏可解释的含义；单个神经元可能对分散的、不相关的输入产生激活。

sentences.en: We introduce coherence, a geometric property inspired by neural coding in the brain, where neurons like grid cells and head direction cells respond to contiguous regions of state space.
sentences.zh: 我们引入连贯性（coherence），一个受大脑神经编码启发的几何性质，其中诸如网格细胞和头部方向细胞之类的神经元会对状态空间的连续区域产生响应。

sentences.en: A non-negative matrix is coherent if each row (sample) attends to geometrically clustered columns (features) and vice versa, and in addition every sample is well described by some feature and every feature is needed by some sample.
sentences.zh: 如果一个非负矩阵的每一行（样本）关注几何上聚类的列（特征），并且反之亦然，同时每个样本都能被某个特征很好地描述、每个特征都被某些样本所需要，那么这个矩阵就是连贯的。

sentences.en: We prove that coherent matrices induce a bounded interleaving between the Vietoris-Rips filtrations of samples and features, guaranteeing that both spaces share compatible topological structure.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，连贯矩阵在样本与特征的Vietoris-Rips滤流之间诱导出有界的交错（interleaving），保证两个空间共享相容的拓扑结构。

sentences.en: This geometric constraint facilitates interpretability.
sentences.zh: 这种几何约束促进了可解释性。

sentences.en: For example, if data lies on a circle, coherent features must tile that circle into contiguous arcs.
sentences.zh: 例如，如果数据位于一个圆上，连贯特征必须将该圆铺成连续的弧段。

sentences.en: We introduce Coh, a differentiable objective function based on Fréchet variance that enforces coherence during training.
sentences.zh: 我们引入Coh，一种基于Fréchet方差的可微目标函数，在训练过程中强制实现连贯性。

sentences.en: Unlike sparsity, which bounds how many samples a feature activates on, coherence bounds *which* samples, requiring geometric connectivity rather than only rarity.
sentences.zh: 与稀疏性（限制一个特征在多少样本上激活）不同，连贯性限制的是*哪些*样本，要求几何连通性而不仅仅是稀有性。

sentences.en: This yields not just interpretable features but an interpretable feature space.
sentences.zh: 这不仅产生可解释的特征，还产生可解释的特征空间。

sentences.en: We validate Coh in an auto-encoder using synthetic and rotated MNIST datasets and in a token embedding of BERT using language data.
sentences.zh: 我们使用合成和旋转MNIST数据集在自编码器中验证Coh，并使用语言数据在BERT的令牌嵌入中验证Coh。

title_en: Learning Compressed Shape-Aware Molecular Representations for Virtual Screening
title_zh: 学习压缩的形态感知分子表示用于虚拟筛选

sentences.en: Virtual screening of billion-scale molecular libraries based on 3D shape similarity remains computationally prohibitive, requiring expensive conformational sampling and alignment, as done by established tools like *ROCS*.
sentences.zh: 基于3D形态相似性的十亿级分子库虚拟筛选在计算上仍不可行，需要昂贵的构象采样和对齐，正如*ROCS*等成熟工具所做的那样。

sentences.en: Here, we introduce *SAND* (**S**hape-**A**ware **N**eural **D**escriptor), a method that can retrieve shape similar molecules from their 2D graph alone.
sentences.zh: 在此，我们介绍*SAND*（**S**hape-**A**ware **N**eural **D**escriptor，形态感知神经描述子），一种仅从2D图就能检索形态相似分子的方法。

sentences.en: Our approach makes two key contributions: (1) a rank-preserving contrastive learning framework using differentiable Spearman correlation that results into representations where similarity strongly correlates with 3D molecular shape overlap (R=0.86), and (2) an end-to-end learned quantization-aware training scheme that jointly optimizes the encoder with a two-level IVF-PQ discretization step, achieving approximately $4\times$ better compression than post-hoc quantization at equivalent retrieval quality.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法有两个关键贡献：（1）一个使用可微Spearman相关系数的保秩对比学习框架，产生的表示使相似性与3D分子形态重叠高度相关（R=0.86）；（2）一个端到端学习的量化感知训练方案，将编码器与两层级IVF-PQ离散化步骤联合优化，在相当的检索质量下实现了比事后量化大约$4\times$更好的压缩。

sentences.en: We demonstrate that *SAND* enables searching over 10 billion molecules in less than a second on a single GPU node - a speedup of $>10^{8}     \times$ compared to traditional methods.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，*SAND*能够在单个GPU节点上于不到一秒的时间内搜索超过100亿个分子——与传统方法相比加速超过$>10^{8}$倍。

sentences.en: We release open-source code and trained weights to facilitate adoption.
sentences.zh: 我们发布了开源代码和训练好的权重以促进采用。

title_en: Learning Context-Conditioned Predicate Semantics via Prototype Feedback
title_zh: 通过原型反馈学习上下文条件化的谓词语义

sentences.en: In scene graph generation, a central challenge is modeling polysemous predicates whose meanings shift across contexts.
sentences.zh: 在场景图生成中，一个核心挑战是对多义谓词进行建模，这些谓词的含义会随上下文而变化。

sentences.en: Prior approaches address this issue by decomposing predicates into multiple static prototypes or retrieving semantically similar exemplars.
sentences.zh: 先前的方法通过将谓词分解为多个静态原型或检索语义相似的示例来应对这一问题。

sentences.en: However, these strategies keep predicate representations static and cannot reorganize semantics to reflect image-specific evidence, leading to systematic confusions in ambiguous contexts.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些策略使谓词表示保持静态，无法重组语义以反映特定图像的证据，从而在模糊上下文中导致系统性混淆。

sentences.en: We propose **AlignG**, which learns context-conditioned predicate semantics via prototype feedback.
sentences.zh: 我们提出**AlignG**，通过原型反馈学习上下文条件化的谓词语义。

sentences.en: AlignG infers context-conditioned predicate semantics from the relation candidates within each image and feeds the adapted semantics back to recalibrate relation representations.
sentences.zh: AlignG从每张图像内的关系候选中推断上下文条件化的谓词语义，并将调整后的语义反馈回去以重新校准关系表示。

sentences.en: The learning objective anchors this adaptation to global semantic centers, preventing semantic drift while still allowing selective reorganization when the scene provides consistent relational cues.
sentences.zh: 学习目标将此自适应锚定到全局语义中心，在防止语义漂移的同时，仍允许在场景提供一致的关系线索时进行选择性的重组。

sentences.en: Experiments on VG-150 and GQA-200 show consistent improvements over state-of-the-art baselines, with F@100 improvements of +1.4 on VG-150 and +2.7 on GQA-200 under SGDet.
sentences.zh: 在VG-150和GQA-200上的实验表明，相对于最先进基线有一致的改进，在SGDet下F@100分别在VG-150上提升+1.4、在GQA-200上提升+2.7。

sentences.en: We further visualize per-image prototype similarity shifts and observe coherent context-dependent reorganization where prototypes selectively merge or separate predicates according to scene evidence.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步可视化了逐图像原型相似度的变化，并观察到连贯的上下文依赖重组，其中原型根据场景证据选择性地合并或分离谓词。

sentences.en: The code is available at https://github.com/Namgyu97/AlignG-SGG.pytorch.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/Namgyu97/AlignG-SGG.pytorch 获取。

title_en: Learning Coupled Continuous-Time Latent Dynamics from Irregular Events
title_zh: 从不规则事件学习耦合的连续时间潜在动态

sentences.en: Modeling dynamic dependencies from irregularly sampled event sequences is a fundamental challenge in modern machine learning.
sentences.zh: 从不规则采样的事件序列建模动态依赖是现代机器学习中的一个基本挑战。

sentences.en: In many real-world systems, individual-level states evolve continuously over time while being simultaneously influenced by population-level distributional dynamics.
sentences.zh: 在许多真实世界系统中，个体层面的状态随时间连续演化，同时受到群体层面分布动态的影响。

sentences.en: However, existing methods typically model these processes in isolation or rely on discrete-time approximations that fail to capture long-range temporal irregularities and sparse observations.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法通常孤立地建模这些过程，或依赖无法捕捉远程时间不规则性和稀疏观测的离散时间近似。

sentences.en: This paper studies the problem of learning coupled continuous-time latent dynamics from irregular events, where individual event sequences and global distributional processes evolve asynchronously and interact over time.
sentences.zh: 本文研究了从不规则事件学习耦合连续时间潜在动态的问题，其中个体事件序列与全局分布过程异步演化并随时间相互作用。

sentences.en: We propose a Coupled Continuous-Time Latent Dynamics (CoCLD) framework that jointly models individual latent dynamics and population-level distributional shifts, and aligns them in a continuous-time latent space.
sentences.zh: 我们提出耦合连续时间潜在动态（CoCLD）框架，联合建模个体潜在动态和群体层面的分布偏移，并在连续时间潜在空间中对齐它们。

sentences.en: CoCLD integrates a Diffusion-based Latent Interpolator with Neural Ordinary Differential Equations (Neural ODEs), enabling principled interpolation, generation, and alignment of latent states across arbitrary time points.
sentences.zh: CoCLD将基于扩散的潜在插值器与神经常微分方程（Neural ODEs）相结合，能够在任意时间点上对潜在状态进行有原则的插值、生成和对齐。

sentences.en: We show that the proposed coupling mechanism yields a consistent estimator of continuous-time latent dynamics under sparse and irregular observations.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，在稀疏和不规则观测下，所提出的耦合机制能够为连续时间潜在动态产生一致的估计量。

sentences.en: Empirical evaluations demonstrate that CoCLD effectively captures dynamic dependencies and generalizes across diverse tasks, including next-event prediction, mobility trajectory generation, and sequential behavior modeling.
sentences.zh: 实证评估表明，CoCLD有效捕捉动态依赖，并在多种任务上具有良好的泛化能力，包括下一事件预测、移动轨迹生成和序贯行为建模。

sentences.en: These results suggest that learning coupled continuous-time latent dynamics provides a powerful paradigm for irregular event sequence modeling.
sentences.zh: 这些结果表明，学习耦合的连续时间潜在动态为不规则事件序列建模提供了强大的范式。

title_en: Learning Credal Ensembles via Distributionally Robust Optimization
title_zh: 通过分布鲁棒优化学习致信集成

sentences.en: Credal predictors are epistemic-uncertainty-aware models that produce a convex set of probabilistic predictions.
sentences.zh: 致信（credal）预测器是具备认知不确定性意识的模型，能够产生一组凸的概率预测。

sentences.en: They provide a principled framework for quantifying predictive epistemic uncertainty (EU) and have been shown to improve model robustness across a range of settings.
sentences.zh: 它们为量化预测性认知不确定性（EU）提供了有原则的框架，并已被证明能在各种设置中提升模型鲁棒性。

sentences.en: However, most state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods primarily define EU as disagreement induced by random training initializations, which mainly reflects sensitivity to optimization randomness rather than uncertainty from more substantive sources.
sentences.zh: 然而，大多数最先进（SOTA）方法主要将EU定义为由随机训练初始化引起的分歧，这主要反映对优化随机性的敏感性，而非源于更实质性来源的不确定性。

sentences.en: In response, we formulate EU as disagreement between models trained under different degrees of relaxation of the i.i.d. assumption between the training and test distributions.
sentences.zh: 作为回应，我们将EU表述为在训练与测试分布之间i.i.d.假设的不同松弛程度下训练的模型之间的分歧。

sentences.en: Building on this idea, we propose *CreDRO*, which learns an ensemble of plausible models via distributionally robust optimization.
sentences.zh: 基于这一思想，我们提出*CreDRO*，通过分布鲁棒优化学习一组可行的模型集成。

sentences.en: As a result, CreDRO captures EU arising not only from training randomness but also from informative disagreement due to potential train–test distribution shifts.
sentences.zh: 因此，CreDRO捕捉到的EU不仅源于训练随机性，还源于潜在训练-测试分布偏移所导致的信息性分歧。

sentences.en: Empirically, CreDRO consistently outperforms SOTA credal approaches on downstream tasks, including out-of-distribution detection on extensive benchmarks and selective classification in medical settings.
sentences.zh: 实证上，CreDRO在下游任务中始终优于SOTA致信方法，包括在广泛基准上的分布外检测和医学场景中的选择性分类。

title_en: Learning Decentralized LLM Collaboration with Multi-Agent Actor Critic
title_zh: 用多智能体Actor Critic学习去中心化LLM协作

sentences.en: Recent work has explored optimizing LLM collaboration through Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL).
sentences.zh: 近期工作已探索通过多智能体强化学习（MARL）来优化LLM协作。

sentences.en: However, most MARL fine-tuning approaches rely on predefined execution protocols, which often require centralized execution.
sentences.zh: 然而，大多数MARL微调方法依赖预定义的执行协议，这些协议往往需要集中式执行。

sentences.en: Decentralized LLM collaboration is more appealing in practice, as agents can run inference in parallel with flexible deployments.
sentences.zh: 去中心化的LLM协作在实践中更具吸引力，因为智能体可以并行运行推理并灵活部署。

sentences.en: Also, current approaches use Monte Carlo methods for fine-tuning, which suffer from high variance and thus require more samples to train effectively.
sentences.zh: 此外，当前方法使用蒙特卡洛方法进行微调，这些方法方差高，因此需要更多样本来进行有效训练。

sentences.en: Actor-critic methods are prevalent in MARL for dealing with these issues; thus, we developed Multi-Agent Actor-Critic (MAAC) methods to optimize decentralized LLM collaboration.
sentences.zh: Actor-critic方法在MARL中被广泛用于应对这些问题；因此，我们开发了多智能体Actor-Critic（MAAC）方法来优化去中心化LLM协作。

sentences.en: In this paper, we analyze when and why these MAAC methods are beneficial.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们分析了这些MAAC方法在何时以及为何有益。

sentences.en: We propose 2 MAAC approaches, **CoLLM-CC** with a **C**entralized **C**ritic and **CoLLM-DC** with **D**ecentralized **C**ritics.
sentences.zh: 我们提出两种MAAC方法：带**集**中式**评**判器的**CoLLM-CC**和带**去**中心化**评**判器的**CoLLM-DC**。

sentences.en: Our experiments across writing, coding, and game-playing domains show that Monte Carlo methods and CoLLM-DC can achieve performance comparable to CoLLM-CC in short-horizon and dense-reward settings.
sentences.zh: 我们在写作、编码和游戏领域中的实验表明，在短时域和密集奖励设置下，蒙特卡洛方法和CoLLM-DC能够实现与CoLLM-CC相当的性能。

sentences.en: However, they both underperform CoLLM-CC on long-horizon or sparse-reward tasks, where Monte Carlo methods require substantially more samples and CoLLM-DC struggles to converge.
sentences.zh: 然而，在长时域或稀疏奖励任务上，它们都逊于CoLLM-CC，其中蒙特卡洛方法需要大量更多的样本，而CoLLM-DC难以收敛。

title_en: Learning Discrete Diffusion on Graphs via Free-Energy Gradient Flows
title_zh: 通过自由能梯度流学习图上的离散扩散

sentences.en: Diffusion-based models on continuous spaces have seen substantial recent progress through the mathematical framework of gradient flows, leveraging the Wasserstein-2 (${W}_2$) metric via the Jordan-Kinderlehrer-Otto (JKO) scheme.
sentences.zh: 连续空间上基于扩散的模型通过梯度流的数学框架在近期取得了实质性进展，利用Jordan-Kinderlehrer-Otto（JKO）方案下的Wasserstein-2（${W}_2$）度量。

sentences.en: Despite the increasing popularity of diffusion models on discrete spaces using continuous-time Markov chains, a parallel theoretical framework based on gradient flows has remained elusive due to intrinsic challenges in translating the ${W}_2$ distance directly into these settings.
sentences.zh: 尽管使用连续时间马尔可夫链的离散空间扩散模型日益流行，但由于将${W}_2$距离直接转化到这些设置中的内在困难，基于梯度流的平行理论框架仍然难以建立。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose the first computational approach addressing these challenges, leveraging an appropriate metric $W_K$ on the simplex of probability distributions, which enables us to interpret widely used discrete diffusion paths, such as the discrete heat equation, as gradient flows of specific free-energy functionals.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们在概率分布的单纯形上利用一个合适的度量$W_K$，提出第一个应对这些挑战的计算方法，这使我们能够将广泛使用的离散扩散路径（如离散热方程）解释为特定自由能泛函的梯度流。

sentences.en: Through this theoretical insight, we introduce a novel methodology for learning diffusion dynamics over discrete spaces, which recovers the underlying functional directly by leveraging first-order optimality conditions for the JKO scheme.
sentences.zh: 通过这一理论洞见，我们引入一种学习离散空间扩散动态的新方法，它直接利用JKO方案的一阶最优性条件来恢复底层泛函。

sentences.en: The resulting method optimizes a simple quadratic loss, trains extremely fast, does not require individual sample trajectories, and only needs a numerical preprocessing computing $W_K$-geodesics.
sentences.zh: 由此产生的方法优化一个简单的二次损失，训练极快，不需要单独的样本轨迹，仅需一个计算$W_K$测地线的数值预处理步骤。

sentences.en: We validate our method through extensive numerical experiments on synthetic data, showing that we can recover the underlying functional for a variety of graph classes, as well as cell type prediction in single-cell trajectory data.
sentences.zh: 我们通过在合成数据上进行的大量数值实验验证了该方法，表明我们能够为多种图类别恢复底层泛函，并能在单细胞轨迹数据中进行细胞类型预测。

sentences.en: Code will be made available at github.com/dariorancati/discrete-gradient-flow.
sentences.zh: 代码将在 github.com/dariorancati/discrete-gradient-flow 提供。

title_en: Learning Discriminative and Generalizable Anomaly Detector for Dynamic Graph with Limited Supervision
title_zh: 在监督有限的情况下为动态图学习判别且可泛化的异常检测器

sentences.en: Dynamic graph anomaly detection is critical for many real-world applications but remains challenging due to the scarcity of labeled anomalies.
sentences.zh: 动态图异常检测对许多真实世界应用至关重要，但由于标注异常稀缺，仍然颇具挑战。

sentences.en: Existing methods are either unsupervised or semi-supervised:  unsupervised methods avoid the need for labeled anomalies but often produce ambiguous boundary, whereas semi-supervised methods can overfit to the limited labeled anomalies and generalize poorly to unseen anomalies.
sentences.zh: 现有方法要么是无监督要么是半监督的：无监督方法避免了标注异常的需求，但往往产生模糊的边界；而半监督方法可能过拟合有限的标注异常，对未见过的异常泛化能力差。

sentences.en: To address this gap, we consider a largely underexplored problem: learning a discriminative boundary from normal/unlabeled data, while leveraging limited labeled anomalies \textbf{when available} without sacrificing generalization to unseen anomalies.
sentences.zh: 为填补这一空白，我们考虑一个在很大程度上未得到充分探索的问题：从正常/无标注数据中学习判别性边界，同时在可用时利用有限的标注异常（\textbf{when available}），而不牺牲对未见异常的泛化能力。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose an effective, generalizable, and model-agnostic framework with three main components: (i) residual representation encoding that capture deviations between current interactions and their historical context, providing anomaly-relevant signals; (ii) a restriction loss that constrain the normal representations within an interval bounded by two co-centered hyperspheres, ensuring consistent scales while keeping anomalies separable; (iii) a bi-boundary optimization strategy that learns a discriminative and robust boundary using the log-likelihood distribution modeled by a normalizing flow.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出一个有效、可泛化且模型无关的框架，包含三个主要组件：（1）残差表示编码，捕捉当前交互与其历史背景之间的偏差，提供与异常相关的信号；（2）限制损失（restriction loss），将正常表示约束在两个共中心超球面界定的区间内，在保持尺度一致的同时使异常保持可分离；（3）双边界优化策略，利用归一化流建模的似然分布来学习判别性且稳健的边界。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of our framework across diverse evaluation settings.
sentences.zh: 大量实验证明了我们的框架在各种评估设置下的优越性。

title_en: Learning Disentangled Multi-Agent World Model for Decentralized Control
title_zh: 学习用于去中心化控制的解缠多智能体世界模型

sentences.en: World models enable learning policies via latent imagination, offering benefits such as history compression and sample efficiency.
sentences.zh: 世界模型通过潜在想象实现策略学习，带来了诸如历史压缩和样本效率等益处。

sentences.en: The primary challenge in applying world models to multi-agent tasks is that modeling multi-agent dynamics in latent space requires integrating information from different agents, often creating spurious correlations between their latent states.
sentences.zh: 将世界模型应用于多智能体任务的主要挑战在于，在潜在空间中对多智能体动态进行建模需要整合来自不同智能体的信息，这往往会在它们的潜在状态之间产生虚假相关性。

sentences.en: Existing methods either reconstruct the observation for each agent or employ communication to maintain correlation during execution, failing to learn disentangled latent states that are crucial for effective decentralized control.
sentences.zh: 现有方法要么为每个智能体重建观测，要么在执行期间通过通信来维持相关性，无法学习对有效的去中心化控制至关重要的解缠潜在状态。

sentences.en: To address this, we present the Disentangled Multi-Agent World Model (DMAWM).
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们提出解缠多智能体世界模型（DMAWM）。

sentences.en: It facilitates learning decentralized policies in the latent space through a novel architecture comprising independent agent modules and a shared environment module.
sentences.zh: 它通过一个由独立智能体模块和共享环境模块组成的新颖架构，促进潜在空间中去中心化策略的学习。

sentences.en: During real-environment execution, agent modules independently process local information to form a factorized latent representation.
sentences.zh: 在真实环境执行期间，智能体模块独立处理局部信息，形成因式分解的潜在表示。

sentences.en: The environment module is then trained to mirror the factorized structure generated by the agent modules, effectively disentangling individual latent states from the interaction dynamics.
sentences.zh: 随后训练环境模块以镜像智能体模块生成的因式分解结构，从而有效地将各个潜在状态从交互动态中解缠开来。

sentences.en: Consequently, imaginary rollouts generated by the environment module more faithfully simulate decentralized execution dynamics, facilitating the transfer of policies from imagination to decentralized execution.
sentences.zh: 因此，由环境模块生成的想象滚动更加忠实于去中心化执行动态的仿真，促进了策略从想象到去中心化执行的迁移。

sentences.en: Empirically, DMAWM outperforms existing model-based and model-free approaches in convergence speed and final performance, with additional visualization demonstrating its efficacy in capturing agent interactions.
sentences.zh: 实证上，DMAWM在收敛速度和最终性能方面优于现有的基于模型和无模型方法，额外的可视化演示了其在捕捉智能体交互方面的有效性。

title_en: Learning Dynamic Stability Landscapes in Synchronization Networks
title_zh: 学习同步网络中的动态稳定性景观

sentences.en: The robustness of synchronization is typically characterized by scalar, per-node stability indices whose dependence on topology is studied via network science or graph neural networks (GNNs).
sentences.zh: 同步的鲁棒性通常以标量的、逐节点的稳定性指标来表征，其对拓扑的依赖性通过网络科学或图神经网络（GNNs）来研究。

sentences.en: We propose a novel upstream task, stability landscapes, which provide deeper insights into synchronization behavior and from which many such scalar indices can be derived.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一个新颖的上游任务——稳定性景观（stability landscapes），它能为同步行为提供更深入的见解，并且许多此类标量指标都可以从中导出。

sentences.en: Crucially, we pioneer a graph-to-image prediction paradigm: learning image-like landscapes as per-node targets directly from graph topology, a formulation we are not aware of having been established elsewhere in the literature.
sentences.zh: 至关重要的是，我们开创了一种图到图像的预测范式：直接从图拓扑将图像类似（image-like）的景观学习为逐节点目标，这是一种我们不知道曾在文献中确立过的表述。

sentences.en: To support this task, we release two datasets of 10,000 graphs each at 20 and 100 nodes with per-node landscape labels, based on a conceptual oscillator model, capturing power grid synchronization behavior.
sentences.zh: 为支持这一任务，我们发布了两个各含10,000个图的数据集，分别具有20和100个节点，并带有逐节点景观标签，基于一个概念振荡器模型，捕捉电网同步行为。

sentences.en: A GNN encodes topology and a CNN decoder renders per-node images, learned end-to-end with good in-distribution accuracy, generalizing across graph sizes and to realistic power grid topologies.
sentences.zh: 一个GNN编码拓扑，一个CNN解码器渲染逐节点图像，以端到端方式学习并获得良好的分布内精度，可跨图规模泛化并适用于真实的电网拓扑。

sentences.en: This demonstrates that stability landscapes, while beyond the reach of conventional network science, are learnable from topology and open new avenues for moving beyond scalar stability indices in biology, neuroscience, and power grids.
sentences.zh: 这表明，稳定性景观虽然超出传统网络科学的范畴，但是可以从拓扑中学习的，并开放式地为在生物学、神经科学和电网中超越标量稳定性指标开辟了新途径。

title_en: Learning Dynamics of Zeroth-Order Optimization: A Kernel Perspective
title_zh: 零阶优化的学习动态：一种核视角

sentences.en: Classical optimization theory establishes that zeroth-order (ZO) algorithms suffer from a dimension-dependent slowdown, with convergence rates typically scaling with the model dimension compared to first-order methods.
sentences.zh: 经典优化理论确立，零阶（ZO）算法会遭受与维度相关的减速，与一阶方法相比，其收敛速率通常随模型维度缩放。

sentences.en: However, in contrast to these theoretical expectations, a growing body of recent work demonstrates the successful application of ZO methods to fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) with billions of parameters.
sentences.zh: 然而，与这些理论预期相反，越来越多的近期工作证明了ZO方法在微调具有十亿参数的大语言模型（LLMs）方面的成功应用。

sentences.en: To explain this paradox, we derive the one-step learning dynamics of ZO SGD, where the empirical Neural Tangent Kernel (eNTK) naturally emerges as the key term governing the learning behavior.
sentences.zh: 为解释这一悖论，我们推导了ZO SGD的一步学习动态，其中经验神经正切核（eNTK）自然地作为主导学习行为的关键项出现。

sentences.en: Inspection of the eNTK produced by ZO-SGD reveals that each element corresponds to the inner product of neural tangent vectors projected onto a random low-dimensional subspace.
sentences.zh: 对ZO-SGD产生的eNTK的考察表明，每个元素都对应于投影到随机低维子空间的神经正切向量的内积。

sentences.en: Thus, by invoking the Johnson-Lindenstrauss Lemma, our analysis shows that the fidelity of the ZO eNTK is governed primarily by the number of perturbations.
sentences.zh: 因此，通过援引Johnson-Lindenstrauss引理，我们的分析表明ZO eNTK的保真度主要由扰动次数决定。

sentences.en: Crucially, the approximation error depends on the model output size rather than the massive parameter dimension.
sentences.zh: 至关重要的是，近似误差取决于模型输出的大小，而非庞大的参数维度。

sentences.en: This dimension-free property provides a theoretical justification for the scalability of ZO methods to LLMs finetuning tasks.
sentences.zh: 这种与维度无关的性质为ZO方法在LLM微调任务中的可扩展性提供了理论依据。

sentences.en: We believe that this kernel-based framework offers a novel perspective for understanding ZO methods within the context of learning dynamics.
sentences.zh: 我们相信，这一基于核的框架为在学习动态语境中理解ZO方法提供了一个新颖的视角。

title_en: Learning Efficient Guardrails for Compliance
title_zh: 学习用于合规的高效护栏（Guardrails）

sentences.en: Autonomous web agents are increasingly deployed for long-horizon tasks, yet their ability to adhere to real-world policies remains critically underexplored compared to standard safety objectives.
sentences.zh: 自主Web智能体日益被部署到长时域任务中，但与标准安全目标相比，它们遵守真实世界政策的能力仍未得到充分探索。

sentences.en: To address this gap, we introduce PolicyGuardBench, a benchmark of 60k policy-trajectory pairs designed to evaluate compliance through both full-trajectory and novel prefix-based violation detection tasks.
sentences.zh: 为弥补这一空白，我们推出PolicyGuardBench，一个由6万对政策-轨迹对组成的基准，旨在通过全轨迹以及新颖的基于前缀的违规检测任务来评估合规性。

sentences.en: Using this dataset, we train PolicyGuard, a lightweight guardrail model that achieves strong detection accuracy while maintaining high inference efficiency.
sentences.zh: 利用该数据集，我们训练了PolicyGuard，一个轻量级护栏模型，在保持高推理效率的同时实现了强大的检测精度。

sentences.en: Notably, our model demonstrates robust generalization capabilities, preserving high performance even on unseen domains.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，我们的模型展现出稳健的泛化能力，即使在未见过的领域也保持高性能。

sentences.en: These contributions establish a comprehensive framework for studying policy compliance, showing that accurate and generalizable guardrails are feasible at small scales.
sentences.zh: 这些贡献为研究政策合规性建立了一个综合框架，表明在较小规模上实现准确且可泛化的护栏是可行的。

title_en: Learning Fingerprints for Medical Time Series with Redundancy-Constrained Information Maximization
title_zh: 使用冗余约束信息最大化学习医学时间序列的指纹

sentences.en: Learning meaningful representations from medical time series (MedTS), such as ECG or EEG signals, is a critical challenge.
sentences.zh: 从医学时间序列（MedTS）（如ECG或EEG信号）学习有意义的表示是一个关键挑战。

sentences.en: These signals are often high-dimensional, variable-length, and rife with noise.
sentences.zh: 这些信号通常具有高维、长度可变且充满噪声的特点。

sentences.en: Existing self-supervised approaches, such as Masked Autoencoders (MAEs), are highly effective for pre-training general-purpose encoders.
sentences.zh: 现有的自监督方法，如掩码自编码器（MAEs），对于预训练通用编码器非常有效。

sentences.en: However, they do not explicitly learn compact, fixed-size, or semantically interpretable latent representations, typically relying on heuristic aggregation strategies such as global average pooling or a designated [CLS] token.
sentences.zh: 然而，它们并不显式学习紧凑、固定大小或语义可解释的潜在表示，通常依赖启发式聚合策略，如全局平均池化或指定的[CLS]令牌。

sentences.en: We propose a novel framework that compresses a variable-length MedTS into a fixed-size set of $k$ latent Fingerprint Tokens.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一个新颖框架，将变长MedTS压缩为一组固定大小的$k$个潜在指纹令牌（Fingerprint Tokens）。

sentences.en: Our architecture employs a cross-attention bottleneck to generate these tokens and is trained with a dual-objective function.
sentences.zh: 我们的架构采用交叉注意力瓶颈生成这些令牌，并使用双目标函数进行训练。

sentences.en: The first objective is a reconstruction loss, which ensures the tokens are \textit{sufficient statistics} for the original data.
sentences.zh: 第一个目标是重构损失，确保令牌是原始数据的\textit{充分统计量}（sufficient statistics）。

sentences.en: The second, a diversity penalty based on the Total Coding Rate (TCR), explicitly minimizes the redundancy between tokens, encouraging them to become statistically \textit{disentangled} representations.
sentences.zh: 第二个目标是基于总编码率（TCR）的多样性惩罚，显式最小化令牌之间的冗余，鼓励它们成为统计上的\textit{解缠}表示。

sentences.en: We present the theoretical justification for our method, framing it as a novel \textbf{Disentangled Rate-Distortion} problem.
sentences.zh: 我们为该方法提供了理论依据，将其表述为一个新颖的\textbf{Disentangled Rate-Distortion}$（解缠率失真）问题。

sentences.en: This approach produces a low-dimensional, interpretable, and sample-efficient representation, where each token is encouraged to capture an independent factor of variation, paving the way for more robust digital biomarkers.
sentences.zh: 这种方法产生低维、可解释且样本高效的表示，其中每个令牌都被鼓励捕捉一个独立的变异因子，为更稳健的数字生物标志物铺平道路。

title_en: Learning Flexible Generalization in Video Quality Assessment by Bringing Device and Viewing Condition Distributions
title_zh: 通过引入设备与观看条件分布学习视频质量评估中的灵活泛化

sentences.en: Video quality assessment (VQA) plays a critical role in optimizing video delivery systems.
sentences.zh: 视频质量评估（VQA）在优化视频投送系统中扮演着关键角色。

sentences.en: While numerous objective metrics have been proposed to approximate human perception, the perceived quality strongly depends on viewing conditions and display characteristics.
sentences.zh: 虽然已有众多客观指标被提出来近似人类感知，但感知质量强烈依赖于观看条件和显示特性。

sentences.en: Factors such as ambient lighting, display brightness, and resolution significantly influence the visibility of distortions.
sentences.zh: 诸如环境光照、显示亮度和分辨率等因素会显著影响失真的可见性。

sentences.en: In this work, we address the question of the multi-screen quality assessment on mobile devices, as this area still tends to be under-covered.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们探讨了移动设备上的多屏质量评估问题，因为这一领域仍然往往覆盖不足。

sentences.en: We introduce a first large-scale subjective dataset collected across more than different 300 Android devices, accompanied by metadata on viewing conditions and display properties.
sentences.zh: 我们引入第一个在超过300种不同Android设备上收集的大规模主观数据集，并附带观看条件和显示属性的元数据。

sentences.en: We propose a strategy for aggregated score extraction and adaptation of VQA models to device-specific quality estimation.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一种聚合分数提取策略，以及将VQA模型适配到设备特定质量估计的方法。

sentences.en: Our results demonstrate that incorporating device and context information enables more accurate and flexible quality prediction, offering new opportunities for fine-grained optimization in streaming services.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，纳入设备和上下文信息能够实现更准确、更灵活的质量预测，为流媒体服务中的细粒度优化提供了新机遇。

sentences.en: Ultimately, this work advances the development of perceptual quality models that bridge the gap between laboratory evaluations and the diverse conditions of real-world media consumption.
sentences.zh: 最终，这项工作推进了感知质量模型的发展，弥合了实验室评估与真实世界媒体消费的多样条件之间的差距。

sentences.en: We made the dataset and the code available at https://videoprocessing.github.io/device-viewing-conditions.
sentences.zh: 我们已在 https://videoprocessing.github.io/device-viewing-conditions 公开了数据集和代码。

title_en: Learning from Comparison: Constrained Projection Policy Optimization for Pareto-Front Improvement
title_zh: 从比较中学习：用于帕累托前沿改进的约束投影策略优化

sentences.en: Constrained multi-objective reinforcement learning aims to discover a diverse set of feasible trade-offs, yet scalarization and signed, normalized group-relative advantages can be brittle under objective-scale drift, near-ties, and feasibility scarcity.
sentences.zh: 约束多目标强化学习旨在发现一组多样化的可行权衡，然而标量化和带符号的、归一化的群体相对优势在目标尺度漂移、近乎平局和可行性稀缺的情况下可能很脆弱。

sentences.en: We propose constrained projection policy optimization (CoPro), which alternates between an E-step moment projection and an M-step policy projection.
sentences.zh: 我们提出约束投影策略优化（CoPro），它在E步骤矩投影和M步骤策略投影之间交替进行。

sentences.en: In the E-step, we solve a Kullback-Leibler (KL)-regularized, moment-constrained projection over each sampled group to compute a nonnegative reweighting distribution ($ q^* $) that promotes feasible Pareto-front (PF) progress, preserves feasibility anchors, and suppresses ambiguous near-ties.
sentences.zh: 在E步骤中，我们对每个采样群体求解一个KL正则化的、矩约束的投影，以计算一个非负重加权分布（$q^*$），该分布促进可行的帕累托前沿（PF）进展、保留可行性锚点，并抑制模糊的近似平局。

sentences.en: This E-step admits a closed-form exponential-family solution and guarantees strictly positive probability mass on feasible anchors whenever feasible candidates appear in the group.
sentences.zh: 该E步骤具有闭式的指数族解，并保证只要群体中出现可行候选，就为可行锚点赋予严格为正的概率质量。

sentences.en: In the M-step, we project the policy toward $ q^* $ via weighted maximum likelihood with a trust-region regularizer, yielding a PF-aligned update direction from comparisons without hand-crafted reward shaping.
sentences.zh: 在M步骤中，我们通过带信任域正则化器的加权最大似然将策略投影到$q^*$方向，无需手工设计的奖励塑形即可从比较中获得与PF对齐的更新方向。

sentences.en: Empirically, CoPro improves feasible PF quality and robustness on constrained multi-objective benchmarks for large language model tool use and analog circuit design tasks; code is available at \href{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CoPro-8A95/README.md}{\texttt{CoPro}}.
sentences.zh: 实证上，CoPro在用于大语言模型工具使用和模拟电路设计任务的约束多目标基准上提升了可行PF质量和鲁棒性；代码可在 \href{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CoPro-8A95/README.md}{\exttt{CoPro}} 获取。

title_en: Learning from Fine-Grained Visual Discrepancies: Mitigating Multimodal Hallucinations via In-Context Visual Contrastive Optimization
title_zh: 从细粒度视觉差异中学习：通过上下文内视觉对比优化缓解多模态幻觉

sentences.en: Multimodal hallucination remains a persistent challenge for Vision-Language Models (VLMs).
sentences.zh: 多模态幻觉仍然是视觉-语言模型（VLMs）面临的持续挑战。

sentences.en: Standard textual Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) often fails to mitigate it due to a lack of explicit visual supervision.
sentences.zh: 标准的文本直接偏好优化（DPO）往往因缺乏显式视觉监督而无法缓解这一问题。

sentences.en: While existing works introduce visual preference DPO by contrasting original images against negative ones, they suffer from a theoretically inconsistent objective caused by partition function mismatches and rely on coarse-grained negatives that could enable shortcut learning.
sentences.zh: 虽然现有工作通过对比原始图像与负向图像引入了视觉偏好DPO，但它们因配分函数不匹配而遭受理论上不一致的目标，并依赖可能引发捷径学习的粗粒度负样本。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose In-Context Visual Contrastive Optimization (IC-VCO).
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出上下文内视觉对比优化（IC-VCO）。

sentences.en: By placing contrastive images within a shared multi-image context, IC-VCO ensures a mathematically rigorous objective.
sentences.zh: 通过将对比图像置于共享的多图像上下文中，IC-VCO确保了数学上严谨的目标。

sentences.en: We further introduce Visual Contrast Distillation (VCDist), an auxiliary reliability-gated regularizer that encourages consistency between multi-image contrastive training and single-image inference.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步引入视觉对比蒸馏（VCDist），一个辅助的可靠性门控正则化器，鼓励多图像对比训练与单图像推理之间的一致性。

sentences.en: Finally, we propose a contrastive sample editing strategy that generates hard negatives via precise semantic perturbations.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们提出一种对比样本编辑策略，通过精确的语义扰动生成困难负样本。

sentences.en: Experiments on five benchmarks demonstrate IC-VCO's best overall performance and the effectiveness of our sample editing strategy.
sentences.zh: 在五个基准上的实验展示了IC-VCO的最佳整体性能以及我们样本编辑策略的有效性。

sentences.en: Code and data are available at https://github.com/OPPO-Mente-Lab/IC-VCO.
sentences.zh: 代码和数据见 https://github.com/OPPO-Mente-Lab/IC-VCO。

title_en: Learning Gaussian Graphical Models from a Glauber Trajectory Without Mixing
title_zh: 从无需混合的Glauber轨迹学习高斯图模型

sentences.en: We study the task of learning the structure of a $d$-sparse Gaussian graphical model on $n$ variables from a single trajectory of Glauber dynamics.
sentences.zh: 我们研究从单个Glauber动态轨迹学习$n$个变量上的$d$-稀疏高斯图模型结构的任务。

sentences.en: Beyond algorithmic considerations, many applications present temporally correlated observations rather than i.i.d. samples.
sentences.zh: 除了算法层面的考量外，许多应用呈现的是时间相关的观测，而非i.i.d.样本。

sentences.en: Moreover, in the classical i.i.d. setting, polynomial-time structure learning from a sublinear in $n$ number of samples is suspected to be computationally hard without additional assumptions on the precision matrix.
sentences.zh: 此外，在经典i.i.d.设置中，若对精度矩阵没有额外假设，仅凭$n$的亚线性数量的样本进行多项式时间结构学习被认为在计算上是困难的。

sentences.en: Motivated in part by this, we design the first polynomial-time algorithm that recovers the conditional-independence graph from a single Glauber trajectory, with a trajectory-length guarantee that does not depend on the mixing time.
sentences.zh: 部分受此启发，我们设计了第一个能够从单个Glauber轨迹恢复条件独立图的多项式时间算法，其轨迹长度保证不依赖于混合时间。

sentences.en: Technically, our algorithm has three components.
sentences.zh: 技术上，我们的算法有三个组成部分。

sentences.en: First, we estimate the conditional variances and rescale the trajectory to reduce to the unit-diagonal case, without changing the underlying graph.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们估计条件方差并将轨迹重新缩放到单位对角情形，而不改变底层图。

sentences.en: Second, we design a local edge test that extracts adjacency information from short update windows by isolating pairwise influence.
sentences.zh: 其次，我们设计一个局部边检验，通过隔离成对影响，从短更新窗口中提取邻接信息。

sentences.en: Third, we aggregate these local statistics using a robust median-based estimator, and prove accuracy despite contamination and temporal dependence arising from a single trajectory.
sentences.zh: 第三，我们使用基于稳健中位数的估计器聚合这些局部统计量，并证明即使在来自单个轨迹的污染和时间依赖存在的情况下也能保证准确性。

title_en: Learning Gaussian Mixture-distributed Prototypes for 3D Scene Graph Generation from RGB-D Sequences
title_zh: 学习高斯混合分布原型用于从RGB-D序列生成3D场景图

sentences.en: 3D Scene Graph Generation (3DSGG) aims to create a structured representation of 3D environment by identifying objects as nodes and their relations as edges.
sentences.zh: 3D场景图生成（3DSGG）旨在通过将物体识别为节点、将其关系识别为边，来创建3D环境的结构化表示。

sentences.en: Existing 3DSGG methods based on RGB-D sequences typically put much focus on the adaption of neural networks to robust node and edge feature extraction in complex 3D scenes, yet ignoring the inherent intra-class diversity within each class and inter-class similarity between different categories associated with nodes and edges.
sentences.zh: 现有的基于RGB-D序列的3DSGG方法通常非常关注神经网络在复杂3D场景中稳健的节点和边特征提取的自适应，却忽视了与节点和边相关的各类别内部固有的类内多样性和不同类别之间的类间相似性。

sentences.en: In this work, we develop GMPSSG, a novel Gaussian Mixture-distributed Prototype mining framework for 3DSGG.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们开发了GMPSSG，一个新颖的用于3DSGG的高斯混合分布原型挖掘框架。

sentences.en: Specifically, we model different categories with independent Gaussian Mixture-distributed Prototype to effectively mitigate inter-class similarity, while employing multiple Gaussian components within each prototype to capture intra-class diversity.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们用独立的高斯混合分布原型对不同类别进行建模，以有效缓解类间相似性，同时在每个原型内使用多个高斯分量来捕捉类内多样性。

sentences.en: Moreover, Prototype-anchored Representation Learning is introduced to construct a well-structured and mutually independent category space;
sentences.zh: 此外，我们引入原型锚定表示学习，以构建结构良好且相互独立的类别空间；

sentences.en: Topology-aware Prototype Interaction is devised to capture implicit co-occurrence priors within the scene, and leverage them to calibrate prototype distributions, thereby ensuring the plausibility of node-edge matching.
sentences.zh: 我们还设计了拓扑感知的原型交互，以捕捉场景内隐式的共现先验，并利用它们校准原型分布，从而确保节点-边匹配的合理性。

sentences.en: Experiments on 3DSSG dataset demonstrate GMPSSG outperforms  various top-leading methods.
sentences.zh: 在3DSSG数据集上的实验表明，GMPSSG优于各种顶尖方法。

sentences.en: Our code is available at GMPSSG.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在GMPSSG获取。

title_en: Learning General Causal Structures with Hidden Dynamic Process for Climate Analysis
title_zh: 学习带隐式动态过程的一般因果结构用于气候分析

sentences.en: Understanding climate dynamics requires going beyond correlations in observational data to uncover their underlying causal process.
sentences.zh: 理解气候动态需要超越观测数据中的相关性，以揭示其底层因果过程。

sentences.en: Latent drivers, such as atmospheric processes, play a critical role in temporal dynamics, while direct causal influences also exist among geographically proximate observed variables.
sentences.zh: 诸如大气过程之类的潜在驱动因素在时间动态中扮演着关键角色，而在地理上邻近的观测变量之间也直接存在因果影响。

sentences.en: Traditional Causal Representation Learning (CRL) typically focuses on latent factors but overlooks such observable-to-observable causal relations, limiting its applicability to climate analysis.
sentences.zh: 传统的因果表示学习（CRL）通常聚焦于潜在因子，却忽视了这种可观测变量之间的因果关系，限制了其在气候分析中的应用。

sentences.en: In this paper, we introduce a unified framework that jointly uncovers (i) causal relations among observed variables and (ii) latent driving forces together with their interactions.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们引入一个统一框架，联合揭示（1）观测变量之间的因果关系，以及（2）潜在驱动力及其相互作用。

sentences.en: We establish conditions under which both the hidden dynamic processes and the causal structure among observed variables are simultaneously identifiable from time-series data.
sentences.zh: 我们建立了条件，使得隐式动态过程和观测变量之间的因果结构能够同时从时间序列数据中被识别。

sentences.en: Remarkably, our guarantees hold even in the nonparametric setting, leveraging contextual information to recover latent variables and observable relations.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，即使在非参数设置中，我们的保证也成立，利用上下文信息恢复潜变量和可观测关系。

sentences.en: Building on these insights, we propose CaDRe (Causal Discovery and Representation learning), a time-series generative model with structural constraints that integrates CRL and causal discovery.
sentences.zh: 基于这些见解，我们提出CaDRe（因果发现与表示学习），一个带有结构约束的时间序列生成模型，将CRL与因果发现相结合。

sentences.en: Experiments on synthetic datasets validate our theoretical results.
sentences.zh: 在合成数据集上的实验验证了我们的理论结果。

sentences.en: On real-world climate datasets, CaDRe not only delivers competitive forecasting accuracy but also recovers visualized causal graphs aligned with domain expertise, thereby offering interpretable insights into climate systems.
sentences.zh: 在真实气候数据集上，CaDRe不仅提供了有竞争力的预测精度，还恢复了与领域专业知识一致的因果图可视化，从而为气候系统提供了可解释的见解。

title_en: Learning Generalizable Skill Policy with Data-Efficient Unsupervised RL
title_zh: 用数据高效的无监督RL学习可泛化的技能策略

sentences.en: Unsupervised Reinforcement Learning (URL) aims to pre-train scalable, skill-conditioned policies without extrinsic rewards, serving as a foundation for downstream control tasks.
sentences.zh: 无监督强化学习（URL）旨在无需外在奖励即可预训练可扩展的、以技能为条件的策略，为下游控制任务奠定基础。

sentences.en: Despite recent progress, we argue that current off-policy URL methods are limited by two critical, overlooked bottlenecks: (1) non-stationarity skill semantic and (2) brittle generalization.
sentences.zh: 尽管近期取得了进展，但我们认为当前离线（off-policy）URL方法受到两个被忽视的关键瓶颈的限制：（1）技能语义的非平稳性，以及（2）脆弱的泛化能力。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we propose GenDa (Generalizable Data-efficient Agent), a unified framework for robust unsupervised reinforcement learning.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出GenDa（可泛化数据高效智能体），一个用于稳健无监督强化学习的统一框架。

sentences.en: First, we introduce a skill relabeling mechanism to mitigate non-stationarity and significantly improve sample efficiency for pretraining.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们引入一种技能重新标注机制，以缓解非平稳性并显著提升预训练的样本效率。

sentences.en: Second, we propose a Complementary Information Bottleneck(CIB), encouraging the learned skill policy to focus on ego-centric features and become robust to distribution shifts for downstream tasks.
sentences.zh: 其次，我们提出互补信息瓶颈（CIB），鼓励学习到的技能策略聚焦于以自我为中心的（ego-centric）特征，并在下游任务中对分布偏移保持稳健。

sentences.en: Through various experiments, we demonstrate that GenDa significantly enhances the scalability of URL with superior generality and sample efficiency.
sentences.zh: 通过各种实验，我们证明GenDa显著提升了URL的可扩展性，具有优越的泛化性和样本效率。

sentences.en: Our source codes are available in the supplementary materials.
sentences.zh: 我们的源代码见补充材料。

title_en: Learning Generalized Label Distributions
title_zh: 学习广义标签分布

sentences.en: Label ambiguity/polysemy is pervasive in supervised learning, motivating a variety of representations beyond the traditional single-label setting.
sentences.zh: 标签歧义/多义性在监督学习中普遍存在，促使人们使用超越传统单标签设置的多种表示。

sentences.en: While label distribution (LD) provides a probabilistic description and has attracted increasing attention, we reveal its inherent limitations, including inconsistency with raw data, distortion of inter-sample order, and limited applicability.
sentences.zh: 虽然标签分布（LD）提供了概率描述并日益受到关注，但我们揭示了其固有局限，包括与原始数据不一致、扭曲样本间顺序以及适用性有限。

sentences.en: To address these issues, we introduce generalized label distribution (GLD), a unified representation that can perfectly recover raw data while preserving inter-sample order consistency, transform into existing forms of label representations without information loss, and capture out-of-distribution samples as well as negative label correlations.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些问题，我们引入广义标签分布（GLD），一种统一表示，能够完美恢复原始数据，同时保持样本间顺序一致性，能够无损地转化为现有形式的标签表示，并能捕捉分布外样本以及负标签相关性。

sentences.en: We further develop GLD learning algorithms and demonstrate their effectiveness through both theoretical analysis and extensive experiments.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步开发了GLD学习算法，并通过理论分析和大量实验证明了其有效性。

title_en: Learning Generalized Trackers with Elastic Token Budgets
title_zh: 用弹性令牌预算学习可泛化的跟踪器

sentences.en: Visual tracking aims to estimate target states in video sequences, with applications spanning diverse computational requirements.
sentences.zh: 视觉跟踪旨在估计视频序列中的目标状态，其应用跨越多样的计算需求。

sentences.en: Recent methods optimize trackers using manually pruned image tokens with a fixed budget to reduce computational costs.
sentences.zh: 近期方法通过使用固定预算手动剪枝图像令牌来优化跟踪器，以降低计算成本。

sentences.en: However, these trackers, once trained, are constrained to perform tracking under a fixed computational budget, limiting their adaptability to real-world computational diversity.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些跟踪器一旦训练完成，就被限制在固定的计算预算下执行跟踪，限制了其对真实世界计算多样性的适应能力。

sentences.en: To address the above limitation, we provide the first exploration of the elastic token budget training framework (ETBTrack), enabling trackers to perform robust tracking under varying computational budgets.
sentences.zh: 为应对上述局限，我们首次探索了弹性令牌预算训练框架（ETBTrack），使跟踪器能够在不同的计算预算下执行稳健的跟踪。

sentences.en: It enjoys several merits.
sentences.zh: 它具备若干优点。

sentences.en: First, we present a novel result-driven importance criteria, in which we optimize a policy network guided by the localization precision of the tracker to estimate token importance, thereby aligning the objectives of importance estimation and tracking precision.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们提出一种新颖的以结果为导向的重要性标准，其中我们优化一个由跟踪器定位精度引导的策略网络来估计令牌重要性，从而使重要性估计与跟踪精度的目标对齐。

sentences.en: Second, we develop a new budget-collaborative optimization strategy, in which we collaboratively optimize the tracker across varying budgets, thereby enabling the tracker to be compatible with diverse budgets.
sentences.zh: 其次，我们开发了一种新的预算协作优化策略，在不同预算下协同优化跟踪器，从而使跟踪器能够兼容各种预算。

sentences.en: Two optimization processes are performed alternately to enhance the capability of elastic inference.
sentences.zh: 两种优化过程交替进行，以增强弹性推理的能力。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on large-scale benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.
sentences.zh: 在大规模基准上的大量实验证明了我们方法的有效性。

title_en: Learning Global Representation from Queries for Vectorized HD Map Construction
title_zh: 从查询中学习全局表示用于向量化高清地图构建

sentences.en: The online construction of vectorized high-definition (HD) maps is a cornerstone of modern autonomous driving systems.
sentences.zh: 在线构建向量化高清（HD）地图是现代自动驾驶系统的基石。

sentences.en: State-of-the-art approaches, particularly those based on the DETR framework, formulate this as an instance detection problem.
sentences.zh: 最先进的方法，尤其是基于DETR框架的方法，将此表述为一个实例检测问题。

sentences.en: However, their reliance on independent, learnable object queries results in a predominantly local query perspective, neglecting the inherent global representation within HD maps.
sentences.zh: 然而，它们对独立、可学习物体查询的依赖导致主要采用局部的查询视角，忽视了HD地图内固有的全局表示。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose \textbf{MapGR} (\textbf{G}lobal \textbf{R}epresentation learning for HD \textbf{Map} construction), an architecture designed to learn and utilize global representations from queries.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出\textbf{MapGR}\（\textbf{G}lobal \textbf{R}epresentation learning for HD \textbf{Map}\ construction，面向HD地图构建的全局表示学习），一个旨在从查询中学习和利用全局表示的架构。

sentences.en: Our method introduces two synergistic modules: a Global Representation Learning (GRL) module, which encourages the distribution of all queries to better align with the global map through a carefully designed holistic segmentation task, and a Global Representation Guidance (GRG) module, which endows each individual query with explicit, global-level contextual information to facilitate its optimization.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法引入两个协同模块：全局表示学习（GRL）模块，通过精心设计的整体分割任务鼓励所有查询的分布更好地与全局地图对齐；以及全局表示引导（GRG）模块，为每个单独的查询赋予显式的、全局级别的上下文信息以促进其优化。

sentences.en: Evaluations on the nuScenes and Argoverse2 datasets validate the efficacy of our approach, demonstrating substantial improvements in mean Average Precision (mAP) compared to leading baselines.
sentences.zh: 在nuScenes和Argoverse2数据集上的评估验证了我们方法的有效性，证明与领先基线相比，平均精度（mAP）有显著提升。

sentences.en: Code is available at   \href{https://github.com/skyshoumeng/MapGR}{\texttt{github.com/skyshoumeng/MapGR}}.
sentences.zh: 代码见 \href{https://github.com/skyshoumeng/MapGR}{\texttt{github.com/skyshoumeng/MapGR}}。

title_en: Learning Graph Foundation Models on Riemannian Graph-of-Graphs
title_zh: 在黎曼图之图上学习图基础模型

sentences.en: Graph foundation models (GFMs), pretrained on massive graph data, have transformed graph machine learning by supporting general-purpose reasoning across diverse graph tasks and domains.
sentences.zh: 图基础模型（GFMs）在大规模图数据上预训练，通过支持跨多种图任务和领域的通用推理，已改变了图机器学习。

sentences.en: Existing GFMs pretrained with fixed-hop subgraph sampling impose a fixed receptive field, causing scale mismatch on diverse tasks, which often require heterogeneous and unknown structural contexts beyond a fixed sampling scale.
sentences.zh: 使用固定跳数子图采样预训练的现有GFMs施加了固定的感受野，导致在多种任务上出现尺度不匹配，因为这些任务往往需要超出固定采样尺度的异构且未知的结构上下文。

sentences.en: We propose **R-GFM**, a Riemannian Graph-of-Graphs (GoG) based foundation model, that treats *structural scale* as a first-class citizen in modeling.
sentences.zh: 我们提出**R-GFM**，一个基于黎曼图之图（GoG）的基础模型，将*结构尺度*视为建模中的一等公民。

sentences.en: R-GFM constructs a multi-scale GoG over-sampled subgraphs at different hop distances and learns geometry-adaptive representations from Riemannian manifolds.
sentences.zh: R-GFM在不同跳距上构建多尺度的GoG过采样子图，并从黎曼流形学习几何自适应的表示。

sentences.en: Theoretical analysis shows that R-GFM reduces structural domain generalization error compared to fixed-scale GFMs.
sentences.zh: 理论分析表明，与固定尺度的GFMs相比，R-GFM降低了结构域泛化误差。

sentences.en: Experiments on various datasets demonstrate that R-GFM achieves state-of-the-art performance, with up to a **49\%** relative improvement on downstream tasks.
sentences.zh: 在多种数据集上的实验表明，R-GFM实现了最先进的性能，在下游任务上相对提升高达**49\%**。

title_en: Learning GUI Grounding with Spatial Reasoning from Visual Feedback
title_zh: 从视觉反馈学习带空间推理的GUI接地

sentences.en: Graphical User Interface (GUI) grounding is commonly framed as a coordinate prediction task – given a natural language instruction, generate on-screen coordinates for actions such as clicks and keystrokes.
sentences.zh: 图形用户界面（GUI）接地通常被表述为一个坐标预测任务——给定一条自然语言指令，生成点击和按键等动作的屏幕坐标。

sentences.en: However, recent Vision Language Models (VLMs) often fail to predict accurate numeric coordinates when processing GUI images with high resolutions and complex layouts.
sentences.zh: 然而，在处理具有高分辨率和复杂布局的GUI图像时，近期的视觉语言模型（VLMs）往往无法预测准确的数值坐标。

sentences.en: To address this issue, we reframe GUI grounding as an interactive search task, where the VLM generates actions to move a cursor in the GUI to locate UI elements.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们将GUI接地重新表述为一个交互式搜索任务，其中VLM生成动作以在GUI中移动光标来定位UI元素。

sentences.en: At each step, the model determines the target object, evaluates the spatial relations between the cursor and the target, and moves the cursor closer to the target conditioned on the movement history.
sentences.zh: 每一步中，模型都会确定目标物体，评估光标与目标之间的空间关系，并根据移动历史将光标移向目标。

sentences.en: In this interactive process, the rendered cursor provides visual feedback to help the model align its predictions with the corresponding on-screen locations.
sentences.zh: 在这一交互过程中，渲染出的光标提供视觉反馈，帮助模型将其预测与相应的屏幕位置对齐。

sentences.en: We train our GUI grounding model, GUI-Cursor, using multi-step online reinforcement learning with a dense trajectory-based reward function.
sentences.zh: 我们使用基于密集轨迹奖励函数的多步在线强化学习来训练GUI接地模型GUI-Cursor。

sentences.en: Experimental results demonstrate that GUI-Cursor surpasses strong baselines in GUI grounding and agentic tasks, achieving superior performance with the same base models while requiring less training data.
sentences.zh: 实验结果表明，GUI-Cursor在GUI接地和智能体任务上超越了强基线，在相同基础模型下实现优越性能，同时需要更少的训练数据。

sentences.en: Further analysis shows that GUI-Cursor learns to adaptively conduct more steps on more difficult examples, and it obtains better spatial reasoning capability on out-of-distribution domains.
sentences.zh: 进一步的分析表明，GUI-Cursor学会在更困难的示例上自适应地执行更多步骤，并在分布外领域获得更好的空间推理能力。

title_en: Learning Hamiltonian Dynamics at Scale: A Differential-Geometric Approach
title_zh: 大规模学习哈密顿动力学：一种微分几何方法

sentences.en: Embedding physical intuition into network architectures allows the learning of dynamics that enforce fundamental properties, such as energy conservation laws, thereby leading to physically-plausible predictions.
sentences.zh: 将物理直觉嵌入网络架构中，可以使学习到的动态强制遵循诸如能量守恒定律之类的基本性质，从而产生物理上合理的预测。

sentences.en: Yet, scaling these models to intrinsically high-dimensional dynamical systems remains a significant challenge.
sentences.zh: 然而，将这些模型扩展到本质上高维的动力学系统仍然是一个重大挑战。

sentences.en: This paper introduces Reduced-order Hamiltonian Neural Network (RO-HNN), a novel physics-inspired neural network that combines the conservation laws of Hamiltonian mechanics with the scalability of model order reduction.
sentences.zh: 本文引入降阶哈密顿神经网络（RO-HNN），一种新颖的物理启发的神经网络，将哈密顿力学的守恒定律与模型降阶的可扩展性相结合。

sentences.en: RO-HNN is built on two core components: a novel geometrically-constrained symplectic autoencoder that learns a low-dimensional, structure-preserving symplectic submanifold, and a geometric Hamiltonian neural network that models the dynamics on the submanifold.
sentences.zh: RO-HNN建立于两个核心组件之上：一个新颖的几何约束辛自编码器，学习低维的、保持结构的辛子流形；以及一个几何哈密顿神经网络，在子流形上对动力学建模。

sentences.en: Our experiments demonstrate that RO-HNN provides physically-consistent, stable, and generalizable predictions of complex high-dimensional dynamics, thereby effectively extending the scope of Hamiltonian neural networks to high-dimensional physical systems.
sentences.zh: 我们的实验表明，RO-HNN能够对复杂的高维动力学提供物理一致的、稳定的、可泛化的预测，从而有效将哈密顿神经网络的应用范围扩展到高维物理系统。

title_en: Learning Hamiltonian Flow Maps: Mean Flow Consistency for Large-Timestep Molecular Dynamics
title_zh: 学习哈密顿流映射：大时间步分子动力学的均值流一致性

sentences.en: Simulating the long-time evolution of Hamiltonian systems is limited by the small timesteps required for stable numerical integration.
sentences.zh: 模拟哈密顿系统的长时间演化受到稳定数值积分所需小时间步的限制。

sentences.en: To overcome this constraint, we introduce a framework to learn *Hamiltonian Flow Maps* by predicting the *mean* phase-space evolution over a chosen time span $\Delta t$, enabling stable large-timestep updates far beyond the stability limits of classical integrators.
sentences.zh: 为克服这一约束，我们引入一个框架，通过预测选定时间跨度$\Delta t$上的*均值*相空间演化来学习*哈密顿流映射*，从而能够进行远超经典积分器稳定性极限的稳定大时间步更新。

sentences.en: To this end, we impose a *Mean Flow* consistency condition for time-averaged Hamiltonian dynamics.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们对时间平均的哈密顿动力学施加*均值流*一致性条件。

sentences.en: Unlike prior approaches, this allows training on independent phase-space samples without access to future states, avoiding expensive trajectory generation.
sentences.zh: 与先前的方法不同，这允许在无需访问未来状态的情况下，基于独立的相空间样本进行训练，从而避免昂贵的轨迹生成。

sentences.en: Validated across diverse Hamiltonian systems, our method in particular improves upon molecular dynamics simulations using machine-learned force fields (MLFF).
sentences.zh: 在多种哈密顿系统上的验证表明，我们的方法尤其改进了使用机器学习力场（MLFF）的分子动力学模拟。

sentences.en: Our models maintain comparable training and inference cost, but support significantly larger integration timesteps while trained directly on widely-available *trajectory-free* MLFF datasets.
sentences.zh: 我们的模型保持着可比的训练和推理成本，但支持显著更大的积分时间步，同时直接在广泛可得的、*无轨迹*的MLFF数据集上训练。

title_en: Learning High-Dimensional Parity Functions with Product Networks using Gradient Descent
title_zh: 使用梯度下降用乘积网络学习高维奇偶函数

sentences.en: Parity functions are fundamental Boolean operations with critical applications across machine learning, cryptography, and error correction.
sentences.zh: 奇偶函数是基本的布尔运算，在机器学习、密码学和纠错等领域具有关键应用。

sentences.en: Yet, learning high-dimensional parity functions poses significant challenges: in a general setting, standard neural network architectures typically require exponential sample complexity, making gradient-based optimization intractable for large number of inputs $N$.
sentences.zh: 然而，学习高维奇偶函数面临重大挑战：在一般设置下，标准神经网络架构通常需要指数级的样本复杂度，使得对于大量输入$N$而言，基于梯度的优化变得不可行。

sentences.en: We demonstrate that compact product-based neural architectures combined with stochastic data sparsity (Bernoulli inputs with $p_e \leq 1/N$) and appropriate hyperparameter choice enable efficient parity learning, with theoretical guarantees of convergence.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，紧凑的基于乘积的神经架构结合随机数据稀疏性（伯努利输入，$p_e\leq 1/N$）和适当的超参数选择，能够实现高效的奇偶学习，并具有收敛的理论保证。

sentences.en: Experiments validate our theory across dimensions up to $N = 100{,}000$, with empirical evidence showing optimal hyperparameter choices for $p_e$ and learning rate $\alpha$, as well as polynomial complexity scaling laws.
sentences.zh: 实验在高达$N = 100{,}000$的维度上验证了我们的理论，实证证据展示了$p_e$和学习率$\alpha$的最优超参数选择，以及多项式复杂度的扩展规律。

sentences.en: This work establishes fundamental connections between architectural inductive bias and data sparsity, opening new possibilities for neural arithmetic, structured reasoning, binary neural networks, and machine learning applied to automated protocol discovery.
sentences.zh: 这项工作在架构归纳偏置与数据稀疏性之间建立了基本联系，为神经算术、结构化推理、二值神经网络以及应用于自动化协议发现的机器学习开辟了新的可能。

title_en: Learning High-Frequency Continuous Action Chunks in Latent Space
title_zh: 在潜在空间中学习高频连续行动块

sentences.en: Modern robotic policies increasingly rely on action chunking to execute complex tasks in the physical world.
sentences.zh: 现代机器人策略日益依赖行动分块（action chunking）来在物理世界中执行复杂任务。

sentences.en: While action chunking improves temporal consistency at moderate action frequencies, it becomes insufficient when the action frequency is further increased (e.g., to 60~Hz).
sentences.zh: 虽然行动分块在中等动作频率下改善了时间一致性，但当动作频率进一步提高（例如到60Hz）时，它就变得不足。

sentences.en: At such high frequencies, policies often fail to generate actions that are both temporally smooth and spatially consistent.
sentences.zh: 在这种高频下，策略往往无法生成既时间上平滑又在空间上一致的行动。

sentences.en: We address this challenge by shifting high-frequency action learning from the action space to a latent space with variational autoencoder (VAE).
sentences.zh: 我们通过将高频行动学习从行动空间转移到具有变分自编码器（VAE）的潜在空间来应对这一挑战。

sentences.en: This formulation significantly improves both temporal and spatial consistency of high-frequency control.
sentences.zh: 这种表述显著改善了高频控制的时间与空间一致性。

sentences.en: To enable smooth real-time execution, we further introduce Reuse-then-Refine, a chunk-level refine strategy that improves continuity between adjacent action chunks under asynchronous inference.
sentences.zh: 为支持平滑的实时执行，我们进一步引入复用后细化（Reuse-then-Refine）策略，一种在异步推理下改善相邻行动块之间连续性的块级细化策略。

sentences.en: As a result, robots controlled by our policy can execute complex contact-rich tasks continuously, with less pauses and jerky motions.
sentences.zh: 因此，由我们策略控制的机器人能够连续执行复杂的密集接触任务，停顿更少、动作更平滑。

sentences.en: Experiments on three real-world contact-rich robotic tasks show that our approach consistently completes tasks with smooth motions.
sentences.zh: 在三个真实世界密集接触机器人任务上的实验表明，我们的方法始终能够以平滑的动作完成任务。

sentences.en: Our code and data are available at https://github.com/tars-robotics/RTR.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码和数据见 https://github.com/tars-robotics/RTR。
